title: Browser Efficiency Tool Upgraded! Anthropic Fully Opens Claude Browser Extension to All Paid Users

content_html:
The deep integration of AI assistants with daily web browsing is accelerating. Recently, the AI company Anthropic officially announced that it will fully open the Chrome browser extension feature of Claude to all its paid subscription users.

As a tool designed to enhance users' daily work and information processing efficiency, this browser extension seamlessly embeds Claude's powerful capabilities directly into the user's web browsing experience. When users browse various websites, review documents, handle emails, or collect information, they can directly call upon Claude for content summarization, web extraction, answering questions, and text polishing without frequently switching between different web tabs or standalone applications.

This full-scale rollout of the feature marks Anthropic's further alignment with users' core workflows in its product ecosystem. By connecting the browser, a high-frequency entry point, it significantly shortens the interaction chain between users and AI large models, making complex long-text reading and web content analysis more intuitive and efficient. As more AI companies begin to focus on browser-side integration, how to empower daily work through lighter and more convenient interaction experiences has become a key direction for competition among large model products in the next phase.
